name: retrieval-phase0
_comment: Offline default. HashingEmbedder models lexical similarity only — use this config to gate the PIPELINE, and the .http variant with a real embedding endpoint to gate QUALITY.

gates._comment: Regression gates, set just under the current baseline. ADR-001 targets recall@50 >= 0.98 once the real embedder and the full 500-1000 query set are in place.
